title: browser-alpha-matting: Client-Side Hybrid Neural & Euclidean RGB Alpha-Matting Kernel for WebGPU and HTML5 Canvas
description:
Zero-dependency JavaScript/TypeScript computer-vision kernel for client-side image segmentation and alpha-channel compositing inside browser memory. Implements 3D Euclidean RGB color-key alpha extraction, hybrid fusion of WebGPU/WebAssembly neural saliency masks (such as briaai/RMBG-1.4) with deterministic interior typographic counter carving, bilinear 4K proxy-mask upsampling, separable O(W·H) morphological boundary erosion/dilation and box-tent feathering, iterative foreground color decontamination, and a zero-copy Transferable Web Worker client bridge.

Interactive browser sandbox testing the full hybrid WebGPU + Color-Key pipeline: https://utilvo.com/background-remover.
